exposure: vaginal breech deliveries in primiparous women
vaginal breech deliveries in multiparous women
cohort: 100 singleton pregnancies with breech presentation over 28 weeks of gestation, estimated fetal weight between 1.5 and 3.5kg, at a teaching hospital in Davangere, India
finding: Perinatal outcomes were better following Caesarean section compared to vaginal breech delivery, and vaginal breech delivery was associated with better perinatal outcomes in multiparous women compared to primiparous women.
mod_finding: Perinatal outcomes were better following Caesarean section compared to vaginal breech delivery.
